meta.name: start-work
meta.description: Execute a Prometheus work plan in Codex with Boulder state, evidence ledger updates, worktree discipline, parallel subagents, and Stop-hook continuation. Use after planning when the user says start work, execute plan, continue plan, resume plan, or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Codex 中按计划自动执行多步骤工作流并支持中断恢复。
copy.tagline_en: Automate multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically execute multi-step workflows in Codex from a plan with resume support.

howto.what: Claude 会把任务当作工作计划执行：先选择或生成计划，再创建状态文件，然后把每个复选框拆成子任务并委托给子代理并行完成，自己只做调度和验证，直到所有顶层步骤完成并记录证据。
howto.when: 用户先完成规划，然后说“start work”、“execute plan”、“continue plan”等，或要求运行 .omo/plans 下的计划时触发。

say.note: Claude 会进入计划执行模式。
Claude 会从 .omo/plans 选择计划并开始。
Claude 会恢复未完成的步骤。

howto.what_en: Claude will treat work as a plan: select or generate a plan, write a state file, break each checkbox into subtasks delegated to parallel subagents, orchestrate and verify only, until all top-level checkboxes are done and evidence is recorded.
howto.when_en: Triggers after planning when the user says 'start work', 'execute plan', 'continue plan', etc., or asks to run a plan under .omo/plans.

say_en.note: Claude will enter plan execution mode.
Claude will select and run the plan.
